messages:
Asha (CS): Hey team, onboarding ticket from OpenBridge — customer reports a repeatable KV-cache rotation issue causing session token duplication and 5–7s tail latency spikes on dedicated pools. Repro steps attached from their support run. Can we triage and decide next steps?

Marcus (SRE): Thanks Asha. Is this only on Dedicated or seen on Hosted too? Any specific model/route?

Asha (CS): Dedicated only so far. Model: redwood-v1-medium (customer on pinned version). Route: /v1/chat/stream with session_resume=true. Occurs during scale-down -> scale-up transitions. Quick notes from customer: "two consecutive responses share same KV seq id, subsequent requests see mismatched cache offsets"

Priya (PM): Repro steps + impact? Are they able to throttle or reproduce on demand? Need severity for roadmap/prioritization.

Asha (CS): They ran a scripted load test. Steps below (copied from customer):
```bash
# reproduce script (simplified)
for i in {1..200}; do
  curl -s -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"model":"redwood-v1-medium","session_id":"openbridge-123","input":"step '$i'","session_resume":true}' \
    https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat/stream >> out.log &
  sleep 0.1
done
# wait, then scale pool down to 0 and back up via Dedicated autoscaler
```
Logs snippet they gave: 
```
[2026-02-15T14:21:03Z] session=openbridge-123 kv_seq=482 emit_token_id=...
[2026-02-15T14:21:05Z] session=openbridge-123 kv_seq=482 emit_token_id=...
[2026-02-15T14:21:05Z] session=openbridge-123 kv_seq=102 emit_token_id=... # unexpected jump
```
They say "after autoscale bounce, subsequent tokens restart at a lower offset and sometimes duplicate earlier outputs"

Marcus (SRE): Hmm. That sounds like KV cache eviction + reuse without clearing per-session offsets. Could be a race when worker rehydrates session state. Can you attach the full out.log and the exact autoscale window timing?

Asha (CS): Uploaded logs to /tickets/OB-452/logs (linked in Zendesk). Autoscale bounce at 14:21:04Z (scale-down to 0 completed 14:21:04Z, new worker ready 14:21:08Z). Customer labels this P2 — it disrupts conversational continuity but they have a temporary workaround: restart session_id on restart.

dev-bot: Alert posted to #eng-runtime: incident candidate — label: potential-kvcache-rotation.

Eli (Runtime Eng): Looping in runtime team. Quick Qs: 1) Are sessions pinned to worker affinity? 2) Does the customer use prefix caching or per-session persistent KV store?

Priya (PM): Also need to know: is this likely to impact other Dedicated customers during normal autoscale activity? If so, we may need a hotfix on the critical path.

Marcus (SRE): From initial glance, autoscaler scales down to 0 which tears down in-memory KV. When a new worker is started it may attempt to resume using a cached snapshot based on session id but mismatch timeline if not fully flushed. Potential fix: ensure KV snapshot write-before-teardown or invalidate cached offsets on rehydrate.

Eli (Runtime Eng): Agreed. Repro is good. Plan I'd propose: 1) Create bug with kvcache tag and attach logs + repro script. 2) Short-term mitigation: on worker startup detect session rehydrate with non-contiguous seq and invalidate KV for that session (safe but may lose short-term cache benefit). 3) Medium fix: atomic snapshot on teardown or durable session store for Dedicated.

Asha (CS): I'll open the ticket and mark P2/P1 if we see customer upgrade risk. Customer asking for ETA and workaround — can we offer the invalidate-on-start as an opt-in toggle for their Dedicated pool?

Eli (Runtime Eng): We can add a runtime flag per pool (disable_kv_rehydrate) as a quick mitigation; low-risk to enable for a single customer. ETA: small change + canary in 3–4 days if prioritized.

Priya (PM): OK — Priya here. I'll log this into the backlog as a customer-driven item. Propose scope: ship opt-in runtime flag for Dedicated pools (short-term), and schedule durable snapshot work for Q2. Assign severity and draft customer comms.

Marcus (SRE): For engineering intake, label bug: runtime/kvcache, customer: OpenBridge, severity: P2, repro attached, impact: dedicated-chat-session-consistency. Linking to ticket id: RB-IN-789 (to be created).

Asha (CS): I've created Zendesk ticket and linked RB-IN-789. Customer happy to test opt-in flag once available. Thanks all — I'll keep them updated. :raised_hands: 

Eli (Runtime Eng): I'll file the GH issue and assign to runtime oncall. Tagging @Priya @Marcus for priority review.

Priya (PM): Thx — please add launch criteria: reproducible failcases, canary with OpenBridge on dev-dedicated pool, rollback plan, and customer comms draft.

Asha (CS): Noted. I'll coordinate the canary test and collect success criteria from the customer (no token duplication over 1M tokens).

Marcus (SRE): Will monitor metrics (kv-miss-rate, tail-latency) and watch the canary.

Eli (Runtime Eng): Good. Closing thread here — will post GH link when created.

Asha (CS): thanks! :coffee:
